news.headline: Wall Street rallies: S&P 500 +1.3%, Nasdaq +1.6%
news.what_happened: US equities closed sharply higher, with tech leading.
news.why_it_matters: Strong Nasdaq is a positive valuation cue for Indian IT; broad risk-on supports FII-heavy large caps.

news.headline: Crude slips ~0.6% (WTI $86, Brent $92)
news.what_happened: Oil edged lower but remains elevated amid West Asia tensions.
news.why_it_matters: Mild relief for airlines, paints, tyres; move is below the 3% threshold so impact is modest.

news.headline: Hang Seng -1.15%, Nikkei +0.8%; US 10Y yield near 5.0%
news.what_happened: Mixed Asia; China weak while US yields hover at ~5%.
news.why_it_matters: High US yields cap FII appetite for EMs; weak China is a mild negative for metals.

news.headline: Nifty closed +0.84% at 25,255 on Nov 11
news.what_happened: Indian benchmark gained after Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
news.why_it_matters: Market has already rallied; gap-up chasing carries risk. Today is weekly expiry.

picks.logic: Strong US tech close re-rates Indian IT large caps; TCS is the sector bellwether with heavy FII ownership.
Infosys trades closely with Nasdaq sentiment and US discretionary tech spend.
Highest FII ownership among Indian banks; global risk-on flows tend to favour it.

risks: Weekly options expiry today - avoid aggressive entries at open
GIFT Nifty and FII data unavailable this morning; Nifty already rallied 0.84% yesterday

Elevated crude and West Asia tensions
